newsitem.title: UK: London white sugar ends firmer but off highs.
newsitem.headline: London white sugar ends firmer but off highs.

text.p: London white sugar futures finished firmer on Thursday, although light buying failed to pull prices above the psychological $300 per tonne level.

Commission house buying in the spot contract boosted values as the London market recovered from a recent fierce bout of selling, traders said. Overall volume was swollen by trade May crosses and May/August spread deals.
But activity was generally quiet as the market consolidated after the fireworks seen on Tuesday when March tumbled $8.00 on arbitrage sales against the raws market to hit a low of $296.70.
March came off a high of $299.80, but still ended $0.50 stronger at $298.20. May last traded at $298.00, up $0.40 and overall volume was 1,583 lots. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 2936
